latestVersion.changelog: Harden capability discovery, issue identity and scope, credential handling, and bounded approval-gated writes.

raw_record.summary: Read, search, draft, create, or update Jira work. Use only with explicit Jira or Atlassian context, a Jira URL, or a Jira-style issue key such as PROJ-123; generic mentions of an issue, ticket, sprint, or backlog are not sufficient.
